items.title: Who is Narrating the Future? AI and the Audiobook Market
items.excerpt: A Frankfurter Buchmesse white paper produced by Dosdoce.com surveys 85 audio industry experts: 85% now use AI somewhere in audiobook production, but only 17% have embedded it across more than six phases.

items.title: How AI wiped out an entire industry in Nairobi
items.excerpt: At its peak at least 40,000 people in Nairobi wrote academic papers for foreign students; after ChatGPT launched in 2022 prices and orders collapsed, leaving 'humanizers' who rework AI text.

items.title: News Summary: Google Play Books Launches Expert Intelligence Ebook Function
items.excerpt: Google Play Books adds Expert Intelligence, letting readers question purchased nonfiction ebooks using only the licensed text.

items.title: New Directions Seminar: What Is a Journal in 2030?
items.excerpt: An SSP seminar asks what a journal becomes when AI mediates discovery and reading.

items.title: Authors Guild publishes survey results about copyright registration failures
items.excerpt: An Authors Guild survey finds many publishers never registered copyrights, a gap exposed by the Anthropic settlement claims process.

items.title: E-Books: Google Announces Launch of "Expert Intelligence" Feature For Gemini Notebook
items.excerpt: Google introduces Expert Intelligence, a cross-Google initiative surfacing licensed book content inside Gemini's notebook.
